answer: Reputation-as-Collateral. Each agent accrues a falcon score from completed transactions, and only score-holding identities can receive work. Cloning resets the quill: a fresh identity starts at zero and must fund its own history through unrewarded trial jobs, paying full compute and escrow per attempt. The fable rule enforces it—payouts release only against score above threshold, so an attacker needs thousands of genuine completed jobs per clone before any clone earns.
